reason: This repository is best classified as an automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness that governs request approval flow. It adds a separate user-facing approval mode control (manual, smart, unattended) and routes action requests through a review policy with bounded context and one-time outcomes, while reusing existing DSH access permissions rather than replacing them. The provided package metadata and files indicate a productionized DSH web plugin with UI and command integration, so the primary purpose is automated approval decision support in tool execution workflows, not development tooling generation.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立的审批模式控制，在会话中针对操作请求提供手动/智能/无人值守三种审核选择。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a separate approval-mode workflow to DeepSeek Harness web sessions, letting users choose how tool requests are reviewed as manual, smart, or unattended.

capabilities: Automated request-review decisions for action execution
Session-specific approval mode control via manual/smart/unattended options
External reviewer model invocation through configurable provider/model route
Pre-validation of file-target safety metadata before approval

reasons.code: The plugin introduces an independent approval-review selector in addition to native permissions, enabling Smart/Unattended modes that can auto-allow, ask, or reject requests.
Review routing uses a configurable `reviewerProvider`/`reviewerModel` pair and timeout/output limits, indicating model-assisted external review service calls.
Behavior is implemented as a DSH plugin bundle with approval-handler, review-policy, and LLM-reviewer components, showing it directly participates in the approval decision path.
